qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the transmission socket to case connection on 4HP-22 EH/4HP-24EH/A5S 310Z transmissions?
What screw size is used for the transmission socket to case connection on A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions?
What is the difference in torque specification between the 4HP-22 EH/4HP-24EH/A5S 310Z and A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmission socket connections?
qa_pairs.answer: The 4HP-22 EH/4HP-24EH/A5S 310Z requires 12 Nm while the A4S 270R/A4S 310R requires 14 Nm, a difference of 2 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What component is being torqued according to the 1AZ specification?
What section of the manual covers Wire Harness, Shift Elements and Sensor specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 24 35 under the Automatic Transmission chapter (24-13).

qa_pairs.question: Do both transmission types use the same screw size for the socket to case connection?
What is the unit of measurement for the torque specifications shown?
Which transmission type requires higher torque for the socket to case connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The A4S 270R/A4S 310R requires higher torque at 14 Nm compared to the 4HP-22 EH/4HP-24EH/A5S 310Z at 12 Nm.
